recentItems.title: Why you can’t predict a disaster like Nepal’s flood | About That
recentItems.description:
A collapsed glacier in Nepal caused catastrophic flooding that killed more than a thousand people, while thousands more are still missing. Andrew Chang breaks down what accelerated the flood to such a violent degree and how factors like the scale of the Himalayan mountains and the region's climate make prediction and monitoring so challenging.

recentItems.title: 'Supersized' El Niño expected, raising extreme weather risks: UN weather agency
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Ontario university student suspected of spying for China
recentItems.description:
University of Waterloo student Weiheng Zeng is suspected of espionage after the FBI said he admitted to accessing U.S. and Canadian airport facilities to photograph planes on behalf of a mysterious Chinese handler.

Zeng, a Chinese citizen, was arrested in Michigan on Aug. 23 after crossing the Ambassador Bridge from Windsor, Ont. He was charged with one count of making false statements.
